headline: Trump 🍊👑 Says Iran Talkies Start Monday 😱🤝
text:
Orange King 🍊👑 on Air Force One ✈️ told reporters he CANCELLED the biggest strike since WW2 💥🌍 cuz Iran + Middle East bros asked him to HOLD OFF 🛑🤚! 'They saw it forming' he said while flexing that US military power was LOCKED AND LOADED 🔒💪 for levels of terror not seen since the big war! But now it's NEGOTIATION TIME 🗣️🤝 starting TOMORROW AFTERNOON ⏰☀️ - he says the perimeters of a deal are already COOKED UP 🍳🤝!

Saudi Crown Prince MBS 🏜️👑, UAE and Qatar bros all BEGGED him not to pull the trigger 🎯🚫 cuz they smell a deal cooking on Hormuz strait 🚢⛽ and the nuclear ☢️🍆! Brent crude oil went BRRRR 📉💸 dropping 4.5% to $84 while US oil slid 4.6% to $81 - traders celebrating like it's Black Friday 🛍️🎉!

Tehran says Trump's claims are 'nothing but a new lie' 🤥🇮🇷 - Mehr news agency throwing SHADE ☂️😤! Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says Oman talks on Hormuz are 'on track for finalisation' 🚂✅ while acting Defence Minister Majid Ibn al-Reza warns 'we will neither be caught off guard nor remain passive' 🛡️⚔️!

Trump says he ain't looking to KILL PEOPLE 💀🚫 but he's ready to go ANYTIME 🕒💨 - 'We'll just see how it is' he shrugged while Iran hasn't even RESPONDED to his Sunday night tweet storm 📱🌪️! The US president previously warned 'a whole civilisation will die tonight' 💀🌃 but now he's playing nice guy 😇🤝 - classic Orange Man playing 4D chess ♟️🧠!

JD Vance's Pakistan face-to-face talks went NOWHERE 🗺️❌ back in April, but this time Trump says it's different - 'there's a deal on Hormuz and there will be a deal on the nuclear' he promised while his base sweats about midterms coming in November 🗳️😰! Global oil prices doing the limbo 🕺📉 as traders bet on whether this is real talk or just another round of apocalyptic warnings followed by peace dove emojis 🕊️💬!
